lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-2.1
lesson_intro.board_text:
VPC Architecture: The Building Blocks
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Finova apps need a private neighborhood — not a flat public LAN.

Mental model:
VPC = your private AWS network. Subnets = rooms. Route tables = doors.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: Naan Ren. Finova apps need a private neighborhood — not a flat public LAN. Mental model: VPC = your private AWS network. Subnets = rooms. Route tables = doors. Naan demonstrate panren, neenga practice. Least privilege and Region — non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
VPC Architecture: The Building Blocks
• VPC = your private AWS network. Subnets = rooms. Route tables = doors.
• Mistake: Treating default VPC as 'good enough' for production payments.
• Habit: Draw public vs private before you create anything.
